title: Reality Defender named “Market’s Most Complete Platform” by ITMAP
summary: ITMAP.ai names Reality Defender the market’s most complete deepfake defense platform, ranking first in five evaluation areas across nine vendors.
body_markdown:
Enterprises are moving beyond asking whether deepfakes pose a threat to evaluating which platforms can detect them reliably, in real time, and at enterprise scale.


This month, independent vendor intelligence firm ITMAP.ai published its first[ITMAP for Deepfake Defense & Identity Assurance](https://itmap.ai/markets/deepfake_defense_identity_assurance) . The evaluation covers nine platforms across 8 vendor criteria, 52 product capabilities, and 53 ecosystem integrations. Reality Defender is one of only two vendors positioned in the Contenders quadrant, with no vendor yet occupying the Leaders quadrant. Reality Defender ranks first across five evaluation areas and scores above the cohort mean on all eight vendor criteria.


## Where the market is today


ITMAP defines the category as platforms that “detect synthetic or manipulated voice, video and imagery in the interactions where enterprises make decisions, and confirm that a live, genuine and correctly identified human is present.”


That definition matters. It correctly treats deepfakes as an enterprise security problem, not just a content problem. ITMAP’s key findings line up with what we hear from customers:


- **Detecting new generators is the hardest problem.** New generation tools appear constantly, and a detection model is only as good as its last update. ITMAP advises buyers to weigh retraining cadence and performance against new generators more heavily than a headline accuracy figure.
- **The market is specialized, not consolidated.** Most platforms are deep in one channel or modality and thin across the rest.
- **Strong technology and staying power rarely go together.** ITMAP finds that in an emerging market, the deepest technology and the most durable business do not yet travel together.


## Where Reality Defender stands


ITMAP describes Reality Defender as “the market’s most complete platform.” In the November 2026 edition, Reality Defender:


- Ranks first on Innovation, Customer Experience, and Partner Ecosystem
- Scores above the cohort mean on all 8 vendor criteria, one of only two vendors to do so
- Ranks first of 9 in both Explainability: Evidence & Audit, and Model Assurance & Operations, with a perfect category score in each
- Is the only vendor at full support on model retraining cadence and deployment model choice


Those last two points speak directly to ITMAP’s top finding. When generation tools evolve faster than detectors retrain, detection accuracy is a moving target. Reality Defender’s[research-first approach](https://www.realitydefender.com/research) , continuous model retraining, proprietary detection ensembles, and adversarial testing are foundational to addressing this challenge. ITMAP points to “the evidence-grade verdicts and retraining discipline that matter most to fraud and security investigators,” and calls Reality Defender “a genuinely multi-modal platform rather than a single-channel point tool.”


That is how we have built Reality Defender from day one: a multimodal, real-time detection platform that operates within existing enterprise workflows and delivers explainable, actionable intelligence to security and fraud teams.


Reality Defender’s first-place ranking for Partner Ecosystem reflects our strategy of embedding detection directly into existing enterprise infrastructure, including contact centers, telecommunications networks, collaboration platforms, and cybersecurity solutions.[Explore our partner ecosystem.](https://www.realitydefender.com/partners)


## A map that keeps moving


ITMAP updates its evaluations continuously as vendors ship features, raise funding, and win customers. That fits this market. Today’s map is a snapshot of a category that is still taking shape, and no one has claimed the Leader position yet.


We are proud of where we sit today. We are even more focused on what comes next.


The ITMAP for Deepfake Defense & Identity Assurance is free for technology buyers.[Explore the market map on ITMAP.ai.](https://itmap.ai/markets/deepfake_defense_identity_assurance)

*ITMAP.ai, ITMAP for Deepfake Defense & Identity Assurance, Market Strengths & Opportunities Edition, November 2026. All rankings, scores and quotations are attributed to ITMAP.ai and reflect the market as ITMAP assessed it at publication. ITMAP evaluations are updated continuously, so positions may change.*
